verdict.rationale: Productboard provides a REST API, webhooks, and note/feedback endpoints that let teams pipe in feedback from CRMs, support tools, and chat conversations, plus AI-based insight detection to link feedback to features. However, there's no evidence of native, pre-built connectors for specific sales-call, support-ticket, or chat tools (e.g., Gong, Zendesk, Intercom) — capture relies on custom integration work via the API rather than out-of-the-box automatic capture.
